title: We Had 1 Hour to Prepare for a RuneScape: Dragonwilds PvP Battle! #runescapedragonwilds #gameadvisor
author: Game Advisor
description:
We have exactly 1 hour to grind, level up, gather resources, craft gear, and build the strongest PvP loadout we can in RuneScape: Dragonwilds. Once the hour is up, the preparation ends and we head into a custom arena for an all-out PvP battle!

Who can make the most of their hour and put together the strongest combination of weapons, armor, spells, and abilities? Watch to see how we prepare, what builds we choose, and who comes out on top when the fighting finally begins.
